All instructions for this vault live in [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root. Read that file in full before doing anything here, and follow its Operating Rules exactly — they apply to every AI agent and tool, not only Claude.

Key rules in brief (CLAUDE.md is authoritative): never edit anything in `raw/`; `wiki/log.md` is append-only; `priorities.md` is user-maintained — read it, do not edit it unprompted; every factual claim must cite a wiki page or raw file; follow the YAML frontmatter and `[[Wiki Link]]` conventions for all wiki pages.

Workflow commands (briefing, debrief, ingest, query, lint, log, pull-sources) are defined in `.claude/commands/` — open the matching file and follow its steps.
